title: State Bicycle Co Rolls Out New 4130 All Road Flat Bar
content:
State Bicycle Co took its 4130 All Road bike and changed the geometry to accommodate flat bars, resulting in the 4130 All Road Flat Bar ($899.99), and making for an entirely new chassis and stance…

The 4130 All Road Flat Bar looks more like a 90s MTB than it does an all-road bike. This new model blends the past with the best of modern components, offering UDH, hydraulic braking, and Microshift 10-speed shifting. A simple bike utilizing common standards and completely external cable routing for ease of maintenance, repair, and upgrade.

Designed for meandering riding both loaded and unloaded with taller stack and stable handling. The 4130 Flat Bar has 450 mm chainstays across the entire size range, and comes stock with 650b tires with clearance for up to a 2.4″ rubber. For those who prefer a larger wheel, 700 x 2.25″ clearance makes this a versatile bike for a wide range of riders. Speaking of range, the 11-46 tooth cassette delivers, paired with a 40t narrow/wide ring up front.

Best of all, the complete bikes start at just $899.00 USD, with a variety of upgrade options available.

Specs:

  • 650 x 2.1 Vittoria Tires
  • UDH Compatibility
  • Hydraulic Disc Brakes
  • Full Chrome Finish Kit
  • Color Options: Black Stone / Schoolyard Yellow / Mint Chocolate Chip
  • MSRP: $899.99 USD

See more at State Bicycle Co.
